notes: «حدثني مولى، أسماء» names no one: the mawla of Asma' is unnamed in the chain, so kind unnamed; the compiler's own later note on his name is not used; «سمعت عمر» makes Umar the last link, and «عمر» occurs twice (inside «ابن عمر» and here), so the second is written; «وفي الباب عن علي وحذيفة وأنس» and the comments after the matn are the compiler's notes, not links
